title: Who would be interested in a mall world album?
content: I have actively explored lucid dreaming and astral projection, and through these experiences, I have "successfully" manifested the feelings and sounds of the mall world into reality. This creative process has led me to produce numerous songs. I am determined to release an album along with a moniker that draws inspiration from the mall world we encounter in our dreams. This album will feature tracks that embody a diverse range of places, including hotels, airports, highways, vast deserts, beaches, malls, and underground bunkers. The music will be firmly rooted in electronic genres, blending ambient, IDM, vaporwave, and lo-fi. Some tracks will have a degraded, complex sound that captures the chaotic and nonsensical elements of the dream world, while others will evoke a sense of freedom and euphoria. Expect spectrum—some songs will be weird, others will be joyful, and some will delve into darker themes. Hopefully I can garner some interest here.
